files.content:
name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    # Skip docs-only PRs, but always check .github changes and pushes to main.
    paths:
      - "**"
      - "!**/*.md"
      - "!docs/**"
      - ".github/**"
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - run: npm ci
      - name: Verify Chrome browser regression prerequisite
        run: |
          if command -v google-chrome >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            google-chrome --version
          elif command -v google-chrome-stable >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            google-chrome-stable --version
          else
            echo "::error::Chrome is required for the MCP App CSP browser regression on Linux CI"
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Build interactive visualizer example
        run: |
          npm install --prefix examples/interactive-visualizer --no-package-lock --no-audit --no-fund
          npm run --prefix examples/interactive-visualizer build
      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck
      - run: npm test
      # npm test ends with build:public, so any change here means a tracked dist/ file is stale.
      - name: Check tracked dist files match the sources
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code --stat -- dist; then
            echo "::error::Tracked dist/ files are out of date. Run npm run build:public and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi
      - run: npm run test:oauth
      - run: npm run test:conformance
      - run: npm pack --dry-run

  node24-worker-fds:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm

      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test -- --run __tests__/mcp-code.test.ts

  windows-recheck-paths:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - run: npm ci
      - name: Exercise recheck native executable resolution
        env:
          RECHECK_BACKEND: native
        run: node -e "const assert = require('node:assert/strict'); const fs = require('node:fs'); const manifest = require.resolve('recheck-windows-x64/package.json'); const executable = manifest.replace(/package\.json$/, 'recheck.exe'); assert.notEqual(executable, manifest); assert.ok(executable.endsWith('\\recheck.exe')); assert.ok(fs.statSync(executable).isFile()); assert.equal(require('recheck').checkSync('(a+)+$', '').status, 'vulnerable');"
      - name: Exercise recheck JAR fallback resolution
        env:
          RECHECK_BACKEND: java
        run: node -e "const assert = require('node:assert/strict'); const fs = require('node:fs'); const manifest = require.resolve('recheck-jar/package.json'); const jar = manifest.replace(/package\.json$/, 'recheck.jar'); assert.notEqual(jar, manifest); assert.ok(jar.endsWith('\\recheck.jar')); assert.ok(fs.statSync(jar).isFile()); assert.equal(require('recheck').checkSync('(a+)+$', '').status, 'vulnerable');"
      - name: Run !command secrets through Git Bash
        run: npm test -- --run __tests__/command-secret-shell.test.ts
      # Linux CI skips this test because its file system is case-sensitive.
      - name: Share project-server approvals across path casings
        run: npm test -- --run __tests__/project-server-trust.test.ts -t "different casing"
